lessons_used: Account safety/persistence hints, path duration hints, personality headlines, and live generation countdown timers consistently improved performance.
Reordering sign-in after pet or companion selection improved performance, whereas reordering sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Major redesigns, sub-flows, trait selectors, story copy, quality guidance, and estimated time headlines either hurt performance or showed no clear effect.
Flow bypasses and tutorial screens yielded mixed results, winning in early rounds but hurting or showing no clear effect in later rounds.
Notifications and alerts, layout modifications, incentives, permission checks, and wait screen activity tips showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains for major redesigns, sub-flows, copy overhauls, and sign-in reordering after photo upload, while underestimating gains for hints, headlines, and countdown timers.

decisions.title: Pet Restoration Guarantee Hint on Sign In

lessons_next: Account safety and persistence hints on sign-in, along with path duration and persistence hints, consistently proved helpful, though several hints showed no clear effect.
Reordering sign-in after pet or companion selection was helpful, whereas reordering sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Personality-driven headlines and live generation countdown timers were helpful, but general copy overhauls, story copy, and time headlines either hurt or showed no clear effect.
Flow bypasses and tutorial screens had early wins but later hurt or showed no clear effect; sub-flows, trait selectors, and major redesigns consistently hurt or had no clear effect.
Notifications, chimes, layout modifications, badges/incentives, and wait-screen activity tips showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains for major redesigns, sub-flows, copy changes, and post-photo sign-in reordering, while underestimating gains from targeted hints, headlines, and live timers.
